messages:
sam: Heads-up: we've observed a localized spike in decode/failure rate for quant-v4b in ap-southeast during the 02:00-03:00 window. Canary error rate ~4.1%. Thinking a region-scoped runtime pin while we triage. :ear:

maya: Agreed on region-only pin. Can we avoid a model rollback? If runtime pinning buys time we should do that + routing fallbacks.

lisa: Quick note: SDK 2.7 clients have a KV-cache marshaling discrepancy that can surface as decode errors with runtime v3.2. SDK 2.8.1 includes a compatibility shim; publishing now. Recommend blocking auto-unpin until we confirm SDK adoption.

zach: Oncall confirms GC thrash + higher p99 latency on longseq flows. Rerouting to lighter variant is a reasonable mitigation. I'll prepare a fallback list of tenants to divert.

sam: Plan: 1) apply runtime pin scoped to ap-southeast for quantized model group; 2) route 25% of traffic to qn-v4b-lite; 3) disable auto-unpin until SDK advisory complete + 2 healthy canary cycles. Applying pin now.

deploybot: Automated: pin applied -> scope=runtime:v3.2, model_group=quantized, region=ap-southeast, id=pin-1762468000, started=2026-03-23T02:40Z. Auto-unpin disabled while advisory open.

maya: Updated rollout doc with canary watch (decode_err_rate, gc_pauses, p99 latency). Also posted tenant diversion list.

oncall-bot: Alert triggered: decode_error_rate 4.1% in ap-southeast. Monitoring window extended to 20m.

lisa: SDK 2.8.1 pushed to pypi/npm with KV-cache shim and migration. Drafting short advisory for release notes and support channels now.

zach: Holding routing config for 40m. If errors drop <1.5% for 20m across canary we'll re-evaluate unpin. Otherwise escalate to rollback.

eng-platform: Release notes updated: "Regional runtime pin applied (ap-southeast) for runtime v3.2 affecting quantized models due to KVCACHE regression when interacting with SDK 2.7. Action: upgrade to SDK 2.8.1+; temporary routing to qn-v4b-lite applied."

sam: Leaving the pin in place until we see two consecutive healthy canary cycles after SDK adoption or 03:30Z. Will post updates here. :white_check_mark:
